evidence.observation: Purge reduced exhaust oxygen from 28766 ppm at 120 s to 15.6 ppm.
Growth temperature settled to the 750.0 °C setpoint with 44.5% heater power after a transient overshoot to 760.5 °C at 2520 s.
Argon is 99.5 sccm against a 100 sccm setpoint; pressure is stable at 3.043 Torr and exhaust oxygen remains low at 7.5 ppm.
Controller reports running; all required growth-stage sensors are installed.

args.missing_evidence: Post-growth sample characterization is needed to determine whether the target material grew.
